opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected PhD in a historical subject to a UK institution; normally resident in the UK; not in full-time permanent academic employment; current members of the Royal Historical Society. Current doctoral students are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £2,000 for discrete research projects lasting no more than six months, supporting career-building research or activities to enable researchers to produce a discrete outcome (e.g. an article or book proposal).

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD, undertaking postgraduate research in African history. Applications from previous Martin Lynn Scholarship holders are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of £1,500 to assist a postgraduate researcher of African history, in support of their doctoral research.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All historians who are members of the Royal Historical Society and are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (more than 5 years from completing a PhD). Priority to historians without access to research funding.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to support historians to visit archives, historical sites, conduct interviews and attend conferences.

opportunities.title: Postgraduate Research Support Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society who are postgraduate research students studying for a Master's degree or PhD in History. Not open to those who have completed their doctorate.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to enable postgraduate historians to undertake historical research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews.

opportunities.title: Early Career Research Support Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject (excluding periods of parental leave, illness or caring responsibilities). Not open to postgraduate students or those more than five years beyond PhD submission.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to enable early career historians to undertake research activities essential to their projects, such as visiting archives, historic sites and conducting research interviews.
